title: review follow-ups of PR #37557
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (out-of-diff notes of the Contract review record 7194561170 on PR #37557, adopted at ACCEPT 7194640440)

## What happens

PR #37557 (Fixes #37549) cleared the three tests that red the 19 Version tree. Its contract review read three more things on `main` (origin/main 1af67b26-era, read 11-26) that leave the next major boundary partly unguarded:

- [ ] **Version-step gate list.** `.github/workflows/release.yml:825`: the post-version validation runs only `src/kernel/protocol-version.test.ts` from the spec package. None of #37549's three failing files are in that list, and neither is the new region pin in `packages/spec/scripts/build-migration-registry-entry.test.ts`. If `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is moved by `scripts/sync-protocol-version.mjs` inside the version pass, rather than first on `main`, the missing-region gap reds first on the Version PR again (L2 nit N1). Expected: the version pass runs the region pin, or the three tests, before it opens the Version PR.
- [ ] **Refusal text names a fixed major.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts:206`: the non-SemVer refusal reads "in SemVer form (e.g. 18.6.0)". On the 19 line that example names the previous major, which a client is refused for. Expected: the example is derived from the server's own spec version, or names no major.
- [ ] **Standalone objectui layout.** `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts` now reads `packages/spec/package.json` under `workspaceRoot()` at module scope. In a standalone objectui checkout that path doesn't exist, so the file throws on load. The row it serves already presumes the monorepo, so this is low risk. Expected: guard the read, or record why the monorepo is assumed.

Category ①: each item is a named place where the next release step can red again, or a user-visible sentence that is wrong on the 19 line.
Priority: p2. The release step is maintainer-visible and blocked the 19 prerelease once today; the other two items are small.
Business reason: the maintainer's first 19 prerelease (next channel) was blocked by tests the version pass never ran before opening its PR. Without the first item, the next major can block the same way.
Reader: the release/build seat that owns `.github/workflows/release.yml` (area:build). Seat 2 closed its build intake 11-26, so triage routes this card.
Dedupe: searched `review follow-ups of PR #37557` and `release.yml post-version validation protocol-version.test.ts` (open issues), 0 hits.
Related: #37549, PR #37557, #35129.
